tasks.behavior: Tokens sent to the invoice receiver factory can be returned by the refund authority
acceptance: The factory gets a refund-authority recover(token, to, amount); nobody else can call it, and it can't touch a receiver's money.
Contract tests and the fuzz and invariant suites cover it; docs/contracts/rules.md and operations.md describe it; it ships before the first mainnet deploy.
A receiver's refundable() reads 0 off its intended chain, as factory.status does and refund() allows (audit 2026-11-04); a test covers it.
notes: 2026-11-04 Audit 2026-11-04: InvoiceReceiver.refundable() returns the balance on a wrong chain where refund() reverts. Fix: return 0 when block.chainid != intendedChainId. Any receiver change moves the factory's CREATE2 address (vectors test fails), so it ships with this task's redeploy.

tasks.behavior: A send asks Confirm it's you only after the owner holds Send on its Summary, in a step of its own
acceptance: Prepare no longer needs a fresh sign-in; a new approve call does, and answers with the send brought up to date, so the browser signs only one still prepared (R-211, D-49)
The sheet goes Amount, Summary, then press and hold to send; Confirm it's you comes after that as its own step, with Back to Summary, and signing follows a confirmed code (R-213, R-137)
Going back to change the money or amount never shows an old confirm, and each new step fades in place with no slide (R-213)

Confirm it's you says once where the code goes and has one status line under the boxes: sending, a resend countdown, or Try again after a failed send; a full code is checked even after a failed send, and a resend empties the boxes (R-137)
The wallet address step has one name, Paste and Clear inside the field, a one-line hint, and checks the EIP-55 checksum before Continue (R-213)
A merchant's sidebar heads its paid-with pages Get paid, as a freelancer's does, and Payments has its own icon apart from Transactions (R-134)
Receive walks token and network as steps that fade in place with Back, titles the token once chosen, and shows Send's chip over the QR (R-65)
The 404 page uses sign-in's layout: the bar, the landscape strip and one centered column (R-34)
notes: 2026-11-06 review fail by reviewer: Fail on one money-safety gap. After the hold, useSendApproval sets working but calls onSigning(true) only after approve answers (use-send-approval.ts:43-60). While approve is in flight (a Privy call on a fresh session, or the repeat after a confirmed code) the sheet is not locked and Back shows (send-sheet.tsx:169,508,510). Closing sends cancel, but if approve read the send first, Privy still signs it with the sheet closed, and the server may never hold the hash; Back to change the amount can likewise sign the old send. The old Review locked from the click. Fix: lock close and hide Back while approval.working and no confirm step shows (or drop the sign when the attempt was abandoned), with a unit test. Also fix: base.css:183 comment still describes --fw-step-x and slides; R-213 still says the button reads Send 5 USDC and R-214 says pressed, now Hold to send. Should-fix: HoldButton has no path for screen readers in browse mode, which click instead of key or pointer down. Rest looks right: approve gates signing on status prepared, base units via BigInt, one send per hold, FreshSignIn on approve only, openapi and api.md match, EIP-55 check, StepTransition fade with motion-safe, hold fill marked essential. Ran: go test ./internal/httpapi/tests/ ./internal/send/ ok; web vitest 271 passed; ui-web vitest 23 passed; harness check typecheck lint docs-check passed.

2026-11-06 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Re-reviewed d1a84dcf, 8f38e404 and 9464e8f4. Lock: useSendApproval.locked is working with no confirm step shown; the sheet uses signing or locked for close, Back and Sheet locked, so a send given up can't be signed when approve answers late; Back or close on the confirm step cancels it, and start returns without signing. A unit test covers locked while approve is pending. HoldButton acts on a click with detail 0 only; keyboard Space and Enter clicks stay suppressed by preventDefault on keydown and keyup, and a mouse click does nothing. base.css comment, R-213, R-214 and R-137 now match the code. The hourly cap counts only codes never confirmed, which keeps guessing and inbox flooding capped; a new test covers it. Retry-After reaches the web, as the api is same-origin via the Next rewrite. too_many_codes and code_sent_recently count down, and the code boxes stay usable. Ran: go test ./internal/httpapi/tests/ ./internal/send/ ok; web vitest 274 passed; ui-web vitest 24 passed; check typecheck lint docs-check passed.

2026-11-06 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Re-reviewed 6653610f. with-env.sh now keeps RESEND_API_KEY for the api, which sends Confirm it's you codes, and still unsets EXECUTOR_PRIVATE_KEY and COINGECKO_API_KEY for it; the signer and webhooks still never get the email key. api.md and architecture.md say the worker and the api hold it. tests/test_process_secrets.py runs stub programs through the script and prints secret names only; the api case would fail on the old unset line. Note, not blocking: the script cds to apps/backend and loads the real .env, so the test reads local values (names only are printed), and a .env with an empty key would fail it.
